jobs.company: California State Water Resources Control Board
jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist)
jobs.description: To be considered for this position, you must apply at CalCareers.ca.gov. To apply, you must first create a CalCareers account. Once your account is created, you can search for job code 539552 to locate the job posting and apply.   Link: Job Posting | CalCareers  Note:  This position will no longer be available on CalCareers once the job closes on 1/4/2027. No applications will be accepted after the job closing date.  Job Description and Duties  Please note, the Water Boards do not participate in E-Verify.  Are you interested in helping to shape statewide policies that protect California’s water quality? Do you enjoy the challenge of managing a complex, multi-year project? Are you energized by working with a diverse community to improve the health of California’s lakes, rivers, and bays?
